feature_contract.goal: Reduce sparse sand/particle projected-depth classification work for original D3D9 indexed UP and VB/IB batches beyond 2048 unique vertices without changing stereo world/HUD decisions.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Only R30 source depth classifier for 2049..16384 sparse trusted indices and its destructive/parity tests. No shader, visual tuning, FFB, DX11, DXVK, localization or HUD offset changes.
feature_contract.special_work_evidence: Current source falls back to a dense traversal for >2048 touched vertices even with decoded unique UP/VB indices, up to 262144 candidates before 512 actual samples. Count-based source analysis only; actual Quest3 CPU/FPS improvement is NOT measured.
trace_stages: Original DrawIndexedPrimitiveUP and indexed VB/IB decode publish exact unique touched indices and a matching used mask.
R30XyzrhwHasProjectedDepthSignature preserves ascending first-512 source depth decisions by partitioning trusted large lists then sorting only 512.
WorldParticle versus HUD stereo selection, shader/projection, per-eye output and fallback draw behavior remain unchanged, including reset and invalid metadata fallback.
subcomponents: UP large sparse list can quick-select the same first 512 referenced source vertices without a dense 262K-hole traversal.
VB/IB decoder generation reuses the selected subset until the index mask changes, while invalid or foreign hints retain existing dense fallback.
Source negative mutation, randomized mask/draw parity and full exact-SHA Win32 host/game/packaging, Domain Isolation and Full Source Impact validation.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: For 2049 to 16384 trusted UP sparse references, first-512 indices and world/HUD depth classification match the old ascending dense scan.
VB generation cache stores 512 bounded entries, invalid/out-of-range hints reject quick-select and unowned/dense/unsupported masks fall back unchanged.
All existing R30 classifier negative tests, exact-SHA DX9Ex Active full Win32 build, Domain Isolation, HUD Inspector and source impact complete before claiming build verified.

diagnosis.root_cause: Current branch sorts only up to 2048 touched indices. Larger sparse scenes discard the trusted list and densely walk a vertex range of up to 262144 for 512 depth samples.
alternatives_rejected: Do not unconditionally sort all 16K indices, replace exact ascending first-512 ordering, or admit arbitrary unowned hint pointers.
Do not change texture sampling, projection matrices, FOV, render scope, desktop fallback or original D3D9 draw semantics.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Bounded nth_element of trusted 2049..16384 lists followed by sort of first 512, validity and VB generation cache reuse.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: Extended classifier source mutants and randomized ascending first-512 parity across 32K..262K source spans, including untrusted and invalid indices.

runtime_gate: No Quest3/VDXR session; shader/stereo optics and FPS not runtime validated. Preserve original baselines.

hmd_runtime.note: No actual headset runtime pass claimed
